nom: DRMTLGY Tingl Exfoliating Face & Body Pads 60 Count

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin reports the pads strip away dirt and excess sebum and help control the oiliness.
segments.dry: One reviewer whose olive-toned skin tends to look flaky, thick and gray from dryness reports the pads leave her skin smooth, hydrated and even by the next morning.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including one managing frequent retinol-related peeling, report the pads are gentle and non-irritating, but one reviewer with sensitive skin says her whole face broke out in hives and pimples and advises against buying it.
segments.mature: Reviewers with mature skin, including one in her 60s with bumpy, uneven texture, report a noticeable improvement, with one saying the pads outperformed a $4,000 laser treatment for pores and wrinkles.

concerns.aging: A couple of reviewers report benefits relevant to aging: one with pronounced pores and wrinkles says she saw more improvement from this product than from a $4,000 laser treatment, and a 66-year-old reports it transformed her bumpy, uneven texture; another reviewer notes she doesn't have major lines or wrinkles so can't speak to that specifically.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers report the pads caused dryness, flaking or irritation, especially at first or with daily use, while others report waking up with smoother, softer, more hydrated-looking skin; the product instructions themselves recommend reducing frequency if dryness or peeling occurs.
concerns.redness: Multiple reviewers report significant redness, some describing it as feeling like a sunburn or chemical burn, though one reviewer notes her burning sensation did not come with any redness.
concerns.blemishes: Reports are split: several reviewers, including some with acne-prone or keratosis pilaris-affected skin, report fewer breakouts, blackheads and inflamed pimples, but a few others describe severe breakouts, hives or painful cystic-like pimples after starting the product.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report the pads strip away excess dirt and sebum effectively.

aspects.libelle: Visibly lifts dirt, oil and dead skin off the face
Noticeable tingling or burning on application, especially at first
Leaves a slightly tacky residue as it dries
Increases sun sensitivity; sunscreen recommended after use

extraits.texte: ⚠️ I very rarely write reviews but my experience with Drmtlgy products was so awful, I felt the need to caution others. It made my 41 year old skin break out so badly it was painful. I have not had acne since my 20s/teens thanks to a course of Acutane. The only change to my skincare was Drmtlgy. I bought the essential cleanser, Tingl pads, matte tinted moisturizer and under eye color corrector after the Instagram ads finally sucked me in. I immediately felt the "tingle" and not in a good way. It made my skin red and irritated. Within a few days I noticed pimples. I read that the skin may need time to "purge." I stuck it out for about 5-6 weeks until my skin got so bad that my kids asked me what I hit my head on due to the massive and painful zit on my forehead. Within a few days of stopping all Drmtlgy products my skin felt better and within a week redness and pimples were gone. I am confused by all the glowing reviews because I could not have had a worse experience. Do yourself a favor and save your money. 👎👎
I have sensitive skin, so if that is the case for you, do not buy this product. My whole face broke out in hives and pimples, hated what it did to my face 😡

Seems to be doing the trick. In the beginning I did have a couple patches of dry and peeling skin. But it did say to stop everyday usage if this occurs so your skin can get adjusted to it. It tingles a bit which kind of feels refreshing yet alarming if that makes sense. Borderline didn’t know if it’s supposed to sting THAT MUCH, but I felt better after a few times. My face does feel clarified and stripped of dirt and extra sebum after usage. And has helped my oily skin. It be so oily.

extraits.titre: Gentle Exfoliation on My Sensitive Skin
extraits.texte: These Tingl pads from DRMTLGY are an easy way to help me to exfoliate my skin. The waffle weave textured pads are soft and well moistened. I find them to be gentle and non abrasive on my sensitive skin. Using both sides of the pad, I'm able to address my entire face. I felt no tingle and/or sensation with this product's formulation upon application. It's rather gentle. After using the pad and allowing the product to completely be absorbed and dry on my skin, I do find there is a slight tacky feeling left behind on my face. That being said, it's not enough of a residue that it would stop me from using this product. As one who uses retinol nightly, I'm very happy that this exfoliating product doesn't irritate me and fits in comfortably with my skin care routine. I can't speak to long-term anti aging results as that takes time and consistency, but I can share that my face feels cleaner after use. I can appreciate that fact by seeing skin debris that's evident on a pad after use. I've posted some photos to give you a closer look at this product and sincerely hope that they, along with my experience, help you out a bit with your choice . Thank you.

I had very pronounced pores and wrinkles due to a skin condition and I spent $4,000 a year and a half ago for a deep laser treatment which took me a year to recover from. The deep laser was painful during the treatment, my face hurt for a solid week afterward, and then my face was seeping fluids along with blood spots, and swelling for 6 weeks, They said that I should continue to see improvements over the next 12 months but once healed I only rate the effects at about 25% of what I would have expected... I purchased the tingl Face and Body Exfoliator and after two weeks of use, I felt I was seeing more benefits from this product than I realized from the $4,000 treatment. The pads are easy to use, and I can feel the effects of the product on my skin after wiping carefully with the pads. Normally, my skin is classified as sensitive but is handling the tingl product well. I will buy this product again.

This stuff scares me a bit but my olive toned skin likes to showcase all my dryness and so my skin ends up looking flaky, thick, and gray which is no bueno. I want to look like a glowy goddess not a cast away from a Tim Burton movie. So because I’m a sucker for girl math and free money I used my FSA to purchase these exfoliater pads. And I’m very glad I did! They smell super medicinal and if you have open blemishes on your face this is going to burn the soul out of your body. However used correctly I swipe them over my face after cleansing and follow with everything else. But I always wake up with smooth, bright skin! It clears up acne for me and make my skin looks soft, hydrated, and even the next morning! It’s definitely going on my rotation.
Love it. I'm 66 & look fairly good for my age but my face was bumpy uneven texture. I've tried different exfoliating products with some success but this is a game changer! Oh best part? FSA covered.
